status: INSUFFICIENT: only 1 product (Ring Intercom) is a real consumer retrofit device with supporting sources; fewer than the 3-product roundup minimum. Not verified as recommended by 2+ top-10 pages.

products.name: Ring Intercom
products.badge: Best retrofit for wired building intercoms
products.summary: A small box that wires in beside an existing building intercom handset and sends the visitor call to the Ring app, so a renter can answer and unlock the building entrance from a phone. Ring says basic features need no subscription.
products.renterNote: Suits a renter whose building has a compatible wired intercom and a landlord who approves. Caveat: it only opens the building entrance (not your apartment door), gives no video from a video intercom, and Ring says to run its online compatibility checker and check landlord rules first.
pros: Retrofit box that needs only a screwdriver, per Ring and reviewers
Answer and unlock from the Ring app; features work without a subscription per sources
cons: Compatibility depends on your building's intercom; one reviewer reported a long setup that needed a fix from Ring
No video stream or recording from a video intercom
products.scoreNote: Wired into the intercom, so removal needs the original wiring restored; compatibility is building-specific.
